caption:
AI tends to agree with you. Make it argue back. 🧠

Try: "Give me the 3 strongest arguments against this plan, then tell me what would change your mind."

Use it before big decisions, not after.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #decisionmaking #productivity #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Your AI keeps agreeing with every idea you have.
scenes.sub: Here's how to get a real check.
scenes.say: Your AI keeps agreeing with every idea you have. Here's how to get a real check.

scenes.title: Ask for the other side
scenes.user: Give me the 3 strongest arguments against my plan.
scenes.reply:
Arguments against:
- Costs more than expected
- Takes longer to launch
- Customers may not switch
scenes.say: Try this. Ask for the three strongest arguments against your plan.

scenes.myth: If the AI likes my idea, it must be good.
scenes.fact: AI often goes along with you. Ask it to push back.
scenes.say: Myth. If the AI likes my idea, it must be good. Fact. AI often goes along with you, so ask it to push back.

scenes.title: Stress-test an idea
items: Fix the weak spots you find
scenes.say: Three steps. Describe your plan clearly. Ask for the arguments against it. Then fix the weak spots you find.

scenes.title: Ask what would change its mind
scenes.body: It shows which assumptions your plan depends on.
scenes.say: Bonus. Ask what would change its mind. It shows which assumptions your plan depends on.

scenes.say: Save this before your next big decision. Follow TechMendly for a new tech tip every day.
